tool_input.message:
FINDINGS — docs/spec-writeset-admission.tex

CAVEAT: all line numbers and quotes are from the state of the file I read (prior to commit 7732597). The file has since changed and has uncommitted edits, so every line number may have shifted and any finding may already be fixed. Verify each against the current text before acting.

1. spec-writeset-admission.tex:452-457 and :507-512 — "(open\ i).truncLen > 0 \land (open\ j).truncLen > 0 \land ( (open\ i).rootGlob = ztrue \lor (open\ j).rootGlob = ztrue" — ENTRY (:328-330) forces rootGlob = ztrue to imply truncLen = 0, so this disjunct is unsatisfiable and the model never reports a root-glob conflict, contradicting the prose at :470-474 ("a root glob on either side overlaps unconditionally") and pathsOverlap (conflict.go:266-275), which returns true for `**` vs `docs/**`.

2. spec-writeset-admission.tex:343, :478, :564, :948 — "\field{isEI = ztrue \implies isDir = ztrue}" and "\field{squash(raw \comp unwrap)}" — \implies and \comp are math-mode-only symbols from fuzz.sty (lines 291, 314) used inside \field{} (= \texttt{}), which makes pdflatex abort fatally with "! Missing $ inserted. l.343".

3. spec-writeset-admission.tex:536-537 — "\S\ref{sec:opclose}--\ref{sec:opabandon}" — both labels are defined in docs/spec-mission-lifecycle.tex (lines 748, 776), not in this document, so LaTeX emits undefined-reference warnings and the PDF renders "§??–??".

4. spec-writeset-admission.tex:80-84 — "its trailing-slash guard (line~193) and its own \field{HasPrefix} comparison both operate on \field{CanonicalPath}'s joined string" — lint.go:193's strings.HasSuffix(w, "/") tests the raw entry w, not CanonicalPath(w) (which strips trailing slashes, making such a test unconditionally false), and the document's own :769-771 states it correctly.

5. spec-writeset-admission.tex:383-392 and :404-414 — "containedBy = ztrue \iff truncLen \leq \# segs \land ..." — the schemas omit the real function's "if len(fs) == 0 || len(es) == 0 { return false }" (conflict.go:363-365), so an empty file path with truncLen = 0 yields ztrue where the code returns false, despite :374-375 presenting them as "Today's real \field{pathContainedBy}".

6. spec-writeset-admission.tex:872-877 vs :881-883 — "with more transitions because \field{PathContainedByBuggy}/\field{Fixed} fire as additional enumerated schemas" (43180 combined vs 35915 isolated) — report.json shows those two schemas fire 7265 times each (14530 total), so removing them would leave 28650, not 35915, making the stated 7265 delta arithmetically impossible.

7. spec-writeset-admission.tex:469-470 — "the first is \texttt{ws-dir}$\times$\texttt{ws-dir} or \texttt{ws-file}$\times$\texttt{ws-file}" — conflict.go:212-214 documents the same branch as also covering ws-dir × ei-dir, so the paragraph at :468-485 enumerates only 5 of the 6 rules it sets out to walk through (the Z formula itself does cover it).

8. spec-writeset-admission.tex:473-474 — "an entry whose FIRST segment globs claims from the root", conflict.go:303--305 — that exact string is at conflict.go:254-255, not 303-305.

9. spec-writeset-admission.tex:827-828 — "in the same terms \field{pathContainedBy}'s own doc comment uses, conflict.go:339--340" — docs/audited-delegation.md appears at conflict.go:338, not in the cited range.

10. spec-writeset-admission.tex:616 — "Three separate probcli runs back the claims above." — the tool-run table at :892-914 lists six model rows (two of them run at two setsizes each) and sec:validation-admission alone describes two runs, so the count is wrong under any reading. (Lowest confidence of the ten.)

VERIFIED CLEAN at the state I read: fuzz exits 0; labels unique; schema (9/9) and verbatim (5/5) environments balanced; all other conflict.go / lint.go / validate.go citations resolve; "Seven fields" matches ENTRY; "None of the four" matches the theorem rows; decoupled-demonstration figures internally consistent; ethos-vaib/ethos-8ady bead quotes and the spec-mission-lifecycle.tex Non-goals quote are verbatim-accurate; DES-031/032/052 exist in DESIGN.md. No files edited.
